1.w: At that time you will say: “I praise you, O Lord , for even though you were angry with me, your anger subsided, and you consoled me.

2.w: Look, God is my deliverer! I will trust in him and not fear. For the Lord gives me strength and protects me; he has become my deliverer.”

3.w: Joyfully you will draw water from the springs of deliverance.

4.w: At that time you will say: “Praise the Lord ! Ask him for help! Publicize his mighty acts among the nations. Make it known that he is unique.

5.w: Sing to the Lord , for he has done magnificent things; let this be known throughout the earth.

6.w: Cry out and shout for joy, O citizens of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel acts mightily among you!”
